# Britannica Curiosity Compass

> > A personality quiz and learning exploration platform by Encyclopædia Britannica that helps users discover their curiosity type through profiles of notable figures like Marie Curie, Malala Yousafzai, and Grace Hopper.

Britannica's Curiosity Compass offers an interactive personality assessment that categorizes learners into distinct curiosity types, connecting users with historical figures and providing personalized pathways for career exploration and self-discovery in STEM and beyond.

## Main Platform

- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass](https://curiosity.britannica.com/): Main hub for Britannica's Curiosity Compass personality quiz & exploration

## Curiosity Type Profiles

- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass: I'm a Scientist!](https://curiosity.britannica.com/scientist): Scientist personality profile featuring Marie Curie & discovery-driven traits
- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass: I'm an Explorer!](https://curiosity.britannica.com/explorer): Explorer personality profile featuring Malala Yousafzai & experiential learning
- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass: I'm an Inventor!](https://curiosity.britannica.com/inventor): Inventor personality profile featuring Grace Hopper & creative problem-solving
